items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I always talk of him, but I don't know him personally.

ctx.x: There were some other older pianists before your time, I guess Tony Jackson. Did you ever hear him?
I always talk of him, but I don't know him personally.
He left here when you were six or seven years old anyway. Yeah. What about Alfred Wilson? I don't know him.
